PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  August 22, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, August 22, 2019,
at 2:03 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Cheryl Moore, City Clerk’s
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer 2:25

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Ikemefuna asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Ikemefuna reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
August 8, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Teresa Estrada of City of Inglewood Parks & Recreation Department to
host a 4th Friday Food Truck event in Downtown Inglewood on Market Street from Regent
Street to Manchester Blvd., on August 23, 2019, from 4:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. Event will be
staffed with 6 Officers, 1 Sgt., 3 Police Cars and 4 TCO from 1500-2200 hours; All catering
trucks require, Payment of annual business license renewal and tax fees, maintain valid
vehicle registration and insurance for vehicle license plate, maintain valid and current Los
Angeles County Department of Public Health Permit, sales of tobacco, cannabis (including
regulated cannabis products), hookah, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia is strictly
prohibited, contact Inglewood Police Department, Traffic Division at (310) 412-5207,
during the annual business license renewal process to schedule a vehicle inspection;
adhere to route schedule as submitted, only stopping for fifteen (15) minutes at each
location; Coordinator to provide list of invited guests/dignitary list by 08/20/2019, (Invited
dignitaries: political, notable music artists, actors, radio personalities, sports figures,
performers, speakers, or any guests that would attract crowd and/or media). Provide a list
(contact info and products sold) of vendor/kiosks; BARRIERS / BARRICADES, vehicles
shall be used as barriers at the north and south end of event to avoid unauthorized
vehicles disturbing/driving through event without authorization. TCO’s shall be posted at
each end and intersection of streets with vehicles. Physical barriers shall also be used at
designated intersections/locations (Barricades preferred: Meridian traffic barriers,
vehicles, and/or water filled), Barricades to be placed at Road closures – Market Street at
 Permits & License Committee  August 22, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 11

Manchester Blvd., Market Street at Queen Street, & Market Street at Regent Street.
Barricades to be placed at alleys also; No alcoholic beverages allowed, no sales or
consumption/smoking of cannabis products – per current laws and No smoking cigarettes,
cigars, vapes, etc.; Lighting must have adequate lighting for night/dusk hours; for health
and safety a First Aid kit/station to be clearly marked, tents/canopies to be tied down or
weighted down to avoid flying away with wind, any and all cooking areas to have a barrier
from public and children are to be kept away from hot cooking areas, each food
stand/vendor shall have designated trash can for their trash and trash bags, all food items
/ cooking areas & food storage areas to be in compliance with the Los Angeles County
Health Department mobile food facilities and mobile support guide and regulations for food
preparation, care, storage and packaging Fire Safety briefing shall be provided to all
vendors. Fire Safety plan shall be in place (to be overseen by Fire Department); Parking
shall be in designated parking lot areas, notify surrounding businesses affected of event
7 days prior and distribute flyer with contact person for complaints, which must be available
via contact cell phone or hardline on days of event and respond to complaints within a
reasonable time, The area of the parking lot where attendees are expected to gather shall
be clear of motor vehicles. Must separate parking area from area where event will be held;
No drone aerial video/photography without FAA/LAX and PD approval and operator must
have certification/ license to operate a drone and notify PD of plans for use and location.
Drone flight operation safety plan shall be provided to PD; Applicant must adhere to and
obey all local, state, and federal laws, including administrative & criminal municipal codes;
event is subject to inspection by Police and/or Code Enforcement at any time during event;

items; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and Adhere to all
applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage; APPLICANT AND
EMPLOYEES  ARE  EXPECTED  TO  BE  ACTIVE  PARTICIPANTS  IN
CALLING/NOTIFYING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL,
AND/OR ACITIVTY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE OR
RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E. FIRE DEPT.,
PARAMEDICS, CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Motion carried
unanimously. (Activity No. 00276548)
